text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka invites me to watch a so-called

hard-boiled movie at the theater.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the movie is over...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... sob...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhh... That was so good! It's a damn

masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The main character and his best friend
fought
their way to the top of the
school—literally!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And then when he went one-on-one with
the top
of the rival school and they
ended up becoming
friends... Wow!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I guess the best friends are the ones who
push you
to fight with all you've got.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I know my fiercest rival is the one I consider my clos... est...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: B-but I uh, not all my rivals are cool though! One of them's really annoying!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, enough about that! What I'm tryin'
to say
is...
choice_data_list: （ダイワスカーレットのことかな……）

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Don't ya think we should have
a
one-on-one battle too?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Am I wrong? Umamusume and their
trainers have
to understand each other
on a deep level, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And there are some things you can only

communicate with your fists! So let's do
this,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seems like that movie gave Vodka
some...
interesting ideas. I understand
what she's trying
to say, but it's not like
we can actually fight each
other...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seems like that movie gave Vodka
some...
interesting ideas. I understand
what she's trying
to say, but it's not like
we can actually fight each
other...
choice_data_list: 俺たちなら走りで勝負……だろ？
私たちなら走りで勝負……でしょう？
choice_data_list_en: If it's us, we settle things on the track... right?
If it's us, we settle things on the track... right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? A race?
choice_data_list: 俺たちなら走りで勝負……だろ？
私たちなら走りで勝負……でしょう？
choice_data_list_en: If it's us, we settle things on the track... right?
If it's us, we settle things on the track... right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Don't make me laugh!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You? Challenge me? Are you out of your mind?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but you've got zero chan—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Aaaughhh!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: H-hold on... What I just said...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly what the guy in the movie
said
right before he got his butt kicked!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You know, the thug who took one look
at the
main character and totally
dropped his guard!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If the same thing's happening here...
Don't tell me
you're actually super fast?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Hah! A-all right. I guess you're on then.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But not today! If you really wanna do
this, you're
gonna have to wait!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Don't get the wrong idea! I'm not backin'
out or
anything!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I just mean, I just think we've had our fill
of battle
today after that movie... right?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, our fight's on hold for now!
Let's head
back.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And then I'll do some training! Just in
case!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like I've avoided the challenge
for the
time being. Secretly relieved, I
join Vodka for her
training.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Uhhh... What does that even mean?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Whaaaaat?!
choice_data_list: ……好きなところを言い合うとか？
choice_data_list_en: ...How about telling each other what you like about each other?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
C-com...pliments? No way! What's the
point?
...And besides, that's not even a
fight!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I just blurted out the first thing that
came to
mind, so I try to change the
subject. But...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...But I guess, you're on. I'm tough
enough to take
a few.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I-I mean if you need to get 'em outta
your system,
go ahead and fire away.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll be fine. A real bud isn't afraid to take
a fall for
a friend. So hit me with your
best shot!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah! C-come at me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so I list out all the good things I've
noticed
about Vodka since I met her,
until...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Okay, okay, okay, okay! That's
enough,
already!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After compliment number fifty or so, she
suddenly
stops me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, how many do you have?! This is
so
embarrassin', you're gonna make me
pass out!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aughhh! I said knock it off, already!
choice_data_list: 後は、努力家なところと――
choice_data_list_en: Also, how hardworking you are, and—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Geez. How many even was that? You're
wack...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What?! I have to do it too?!
choice_data_list: じゃあ、次はウオッカの番
choice_data_list_en: All right, it's Vodka's turn next.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gulp!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Fine. It's not like me to just take a
beating! Give
me a sec, I'll take ya down
in one blow!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The thing about... you... is...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You're... really nice!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaaah! You're supposed to be
embarrassed,
dummy!
